prompt: An upside-down village hanging from a cliff overhang.

plan.notes: Needs a cliff overhang found by survey; every building should hang from the rock ceiling, roofs against the stone, floors toward the drop.

lots.label: overhang hall
lots.brief: Largest hanging building, chained to the overhang ceiling; the communal heart with lantern-lit windows.

lots.brief: Small cabin inverted from the rock ceiling, roof against the stone, floor facing the drop.

lots.brief: Slim tower hanging down from the overhang edge for watching the valley.

lots.label: chain-bridge workshop
lots.brief: Forges chains and fittings that keep the village hanging; connects homes via bridges.

lots.label: hanging garden
lots.brief: Glow berries and vines grown from the ceiling as a food source.

connectors.notes: Walkway linking the hall and buildings.

connectors.label: Chain bridges between homes
connectors.notes: Chain bridges linking the hanging homes, hall and workshop to each other.

connectors.label: Winch lift
connectors.notes: Rope lift from the winch house to the cliff top and the ground.

rules.label: Everything hangs from the overhang
rules.notes: Buildings are suspended beneath the rock ceiling by chains, not standing on the ground.

waits.words: The chain bridges between the hanging buildings: rope bridges come with a later Architect release.
The winch lift to the cliff top and ground: lifts come with a later Architect release.
Buildings truly suspended from the overhang ceiling: there is no hanging-from-above rule or form yet; the village is laid out first and the hanging is offered when it can be built.

answer.summary: A secluded home-base village of nine buildings in one zone near the founding stone: an overhang hall at the centre, four hanging cabins, a winch house and a lookout tower at the edge, a chain workshop and a hanging garden, joined by a lamp-lit street. The chain bridges, the winch lift and the true hanging-from-the-ceiling rule can't be built yet and wait for a later Architect release; the village needs a cliff overhang found at the site.
